biggest_catch: 'Most' studies pay in the stated range, not all - and non-UCLA participants can only do online studies, with Amazon gift certificates instead of BruinCard deposits.
catches: 'Most' studies pay the stated rate - the range is not guaranteed for every study
In-lab studies require UCLA students/staff; non-UCLA affiliates are online-only
Non-UCLA participants are paid via Amazon.com gift certificate by email (not cash)
Last-minute cancellations are not permitted; each study has a cancellation deadline
Page content last updated ~2023 per index metadata - confirm the rate when registering

notes: Standing subject pool of the UCLA Anderson Class of 2000 Behavioral Lab. Two consistent rate statements on the same official page: $13-$15/hr (Get Involved) and $10-$20/hr (FAQ) - the wider FAQ range is used for the numeric bounds.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($10-$20/hr FAQ range for short questionnaire studies); time: majority are short surveys, plus registration/prescreen estimate

payout_value_note: Hourly cash-equivalent rate from the official lab page; sub-hour studies prorated at the same rate; Amazon gift certificates at face value.

steps: Request a participant account at anderson.sona-systems.com with a valid email
Complete the short prescreen questionnaire to finish registration
Browse studies you are eligible for (online, or in-lab if UCLA-affiliated)
Sign up for a study and complete it (mostly short questionnaires/surveys)
Receive payment via BruinCard deposit (UCLA) or Amazon.com gift certificate by email (non-UCLA)
timing: Paid via BruinCard deposit (UCLA affiliates) or Amazon.com gift certificate by email (non-UCLA).
